'''Swordmancer Flint''' is a {{gear|5|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Hongshan Swordmancers and assembled by the AIC. This equipment can improve the wearer's combat capabilities.|One of the products marketed by the Bureau of Swordmancers in its early days. 
The flint essentially overclocks and depletes the energy reserves of the Swordmancer armor system. It only shines when the wearer brushes against death itself.}}
